dl.card.p: No Python or extra setup required. Download the installer for your operating system and open dashAI like any other application.
dl.help.p: Common questions about installation, security warnings and GPU use are answered in the FAQ. You can also check the documentation or ask on Discord, where the team and the community usually reply within a few hours.
dl.lead: Ready-to-use desktop installers, with Python and every dependency included.
dl.old.error: The version list could not be loaded. You can see it on GitHub.
dl.old.note: Versions before 0.3.0 had no desktop installers; they can be installed from PyPI.
dl.old.p: Installers for earlier versions are kept so experiments run with them can be reproduced.
dl.pip.after: The interface opens at http://localhost:8000. For GPU acceleration, follow the <anchor>installation guide</anchor>.
dl.pip.p: An alternative for every system, including Intel Macs. Installing it inside a virtual environment is recommended.
dl.req.cpu.app: x64 with AVX2 (Intel since 2013, AMD Excavator or Zen+) or Apple Silicon.
dl.req.cpu.pip: x64 or Apple Silicon; AVX2 not required.
dl.req.os.app: Windows 10 and 11 (x64), macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, and Linux x64 with glibc 2.35 or later and FUSE 2.
dl.req.os.pip: Windows, macOS (including Intel Macs) and Linux x64.
dl.req.ram.v: 8 GB; 16 GB recommended for local language models and image generation.
